title: Future of Time Series Anomaly Detection: From Historical Review to Unified Outlook
abstract: arXiv:2610.30628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a foundational problem in data mining, aiming to identify observations that deviate significantly from nominal temporal patterns. Driven by escalating data volumes and application complexity, recent research has yielded diverse architectures, including diffusion models, state space models, and large language models (LLMs). However, existing surveys provide limited coverage of these emerging designs and lack a unified treatment of multivariate anomalies, cross-domain unified modeling, metric reliability, and contemporary evaluation challenges. To bridge these gaps, this survey delivers three core contributions: (1) We establish a refined anomaly categorization and a structured taxonomy of paradigms reflecting modern advances, comparing detection mechanisms and charting developmental trajectories across paradigms. translated_title: 时间序列异常检测的未来：从历史回顾到统一展望
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）是数据挖掘中的一个基础问题，旨在识别显著偏离正常时间模式的观测值。在数据量不断增长和应用复杂性日益提升的驱动下，近期研究产生了多种多样的架构，包括扩散模型、状态空间模型和大语言模型（LLMs）。然而，现有综述对这些新兴设计的覆盖有限，且缺乏对多变量异常、跨领域统一建模、指标可靠性以及当代评估挑战的统一处理。为弥补这些空白，本综述提供了三项核心贡献：（1）我们建立了一个精细的异常分类体系和一个反映现代进展的结构化范式分类法，比较了各范式的检测机制并描绘了其发展轨迹；（2）我们对评估方法进行了广泛分析，并开展了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了时间序列异常检测领域，建立了精细的异常分类体系，并构建了涵盖扩散模型、状态空间模型和大语言模型等新兴范式的结构化分类框架，同时对评估方法与指标可靠性进行了统一分析，为该领域的未来发展指明了方向。
en_tdlr: This survey offers a unified outlook on time series anomaly detection by establishing a refined anomaly taxonomy and a structured classification of emerging paradigms—including diffusion models, state space models, and LLMs—while providing an extensive analysis of evaluation methodologies and metric reliability.
